snapshot.text: Free, tax-funded public system centred on Seychelles Hospital, with patients sent abroad (notably India) for specialised care. The health ministry concluded a vision workshop with a reform roadmap, and a 2026 bill repeals the Health Care Agency.

priorities.title: Health reform roadmap
priorities.text: A ministry vision workshop ended with a reform roadmap.

priorities.title: Cancer medicines
priorities.text: Cancer medicine stocks were secured and access to specialised treatment expanded.
